research.notes: Public housing agency; no EIN, CA entity number or UEI looked up (not nonprofit registry entities). No general email published on the site, only a contact form. Identity also supported by https://www.oakha.org/residents/educationinitiative/ (OHA and OUSD partnership).

profile.summary: The Oakland Housing Authority is a public agency that provides affordable housing for low-income people in Oakland, California. It manages public housing and administers voucher programs such as Section 8. It also partners with community organizations to connect residents with health, education and social services.

review.notes: The Oakland Housing Authority is the Oakland public housing agency, and its own Education Initiative page describes a partnership with OUSD, which fits an MOU with OUSD. The cited oakha.org pages support the legal name, org type, website, phone, address and neutral summary, and no personal contact details are included.
